svg.title: Chart of yearly cost by AllCoaching plan against yearly sales: yearly Starter lowest below ₹2.4 lakh, yearly Growth to ₹4.7 lakh, monthly Starter at 0% above that, with no sales limit
svg.text: Yearly cost = plan price + platform fee on sales, before GST. Monthly plans × 12.
Solid = yearly plans, dashed = monthly 0% plans (no sales limit). Shaded blue = lowest cost. Illustrative, ex-GST.
